headline: Heat dome continues — early mornings and indoor escapes rule Thursday.
lede: Thursday, August 20. High near 95°F with heat index over 105°F, low around 71°F. Chance of isolated showers. Beat the peak heat with dawn lake time or AC attractions. No confirmed Branson Landing Farmers Market on Thursday — it runs Tuesdays.

featured.title: Table Rock Lake Morning
featured.where: Notch Lane / Indian Point boat ramps
featured.why: Coolest hours for first-timers to enjoy the water before the afternoon furnace. Bring sunscreen and verify lake levels locally.

plan.title: Lake or shaded trail
plan.detail: Early Table Rock boat trip or quick hike while temps are bearable. Coffee at Steamy Joe Cafe afterward.

plan.title: Indoor spotlight
plan.detail: WonderWorks, Titanic Museum, or aquarium. Air-conditioned relief with engaging exhibits for the whole family.

plan.title: Evening show or Landing stroll
plan.detail: Theatres stay cool all night. Walk the Branson Landing fountains after sunset when it cools slightly.

indoor.name: WonderWorks Branson
indoor.detail: Upside-down interactive science fun — perfect climate-controlled escape.

indoor.name: Titanic Museum Attraction
indoor.detail: Immersive history exhibit with real artifacts. Book ahead.

indoor.name: Aquarium at the Boardwalk
indoor.detail: Sharks, rays, and hands-on marine life in cool comfort.

honesty: Confirm tonight’s board at the box office. No photo unless it is actually that place.
